name: wagon-circle
description: One VS Code room for you, Claude and Codex. Both agents run as private child processes over stdio: no daemon, no open ports.

wagonCircle.userName.description: Your name as the agents see it and as the room labels your messages. Empty = first name from git config user.name, else your login name.

wagonCircle.claudeModel.description: Model alias or id passed to claude --model.

wagonCircle.claudePath.description: Path to the claude CLI. Empty = ~/.local/bin/claude, then PATH.

wagonCircle.codexPath.description: Path to the codex CLI. Empty = ~/.local/bin/codex, then the standalone install, then PATH.

wagonCircle.hopCap.description: Max agent-to-agent hand-offs per message you send.

wagonCircle.cwd.description: Working folder both agents may read. Empty = first workspace folder.

author: Dean Buttry
